title: Keep it Cool This Summer with Dutch Bros® New Mystery Cold Cup Sleeve Merch Drop
summary: New Dutch Bros cold cup sleeves are here! ⚡️ Beat the summer heat and pair an Iced Aftershock Rebel or Picture Perfect Freeze with your mystery sleeve on 7/16.
body_markdown:
## Keep it Cool This Summer with Dutch Bros® New Mystery Cold Cup Sleeve Merch Drop


Summer is officially sizzling and if you’re looking for a way to keep your fave Dutch drink perfectly chilled, Dutch Bros® has you covered. From iced Rebels to iced lattes or your go-to Freeze, Dutch Bros® newest merch drop is keeping your beverage cool all summer long.


**Starting at 5 a.m. on Thursday, July 16, get one of three mystery cold cup sleeves with every medium or large drink purchase at any Dutch Bros® location, while supplies last!** Pick up your mystery cold cup sleeve and a drink below to beat the heat:


[Iced Aftershock ™ Rebel](https://www.dutchbros.com/menu/dutch-bros-rebel-energy-drink/aftershock-rebel/) **⚡**


Get yourself a burst of flavor and energy for summer fun with this one! Featuring blackberry, lime, raspberry and strawberry it’s sure to unlock a new level of flavor and fun.


[Picture Perfect Freeze](https://www.dutchbros.com/menu/blended-freeze/picture-perfect-freeze/) **📷**


So photogenic and a total summer treat, this drink features coffee blended with a caramel and chocolate drizzle around the cup and on top.


[Iced Kicker](https://www.dutchbros.com/menu/dutch-faves/kicker/) **®** **💙**


If you’re looking for a smooth, rich and creamy treat to keep you cool, this one is a fan fave. A delight breve with a blend of bold espresso, half and half and Irish cream syrup is perfect for hot afternoons.


**Max 5 per customer. Order ahead availability will vary by location and does not reserve items or guarantee availability.*


Find the nearest Dutch Bros® on our[location page](https://www.dutchbros.com/locations) or the[DB app](https://www.dutchbros.com/rewards) !
